scheme_name: HDFC Flexi Cap Direct Plan Growth

key_metrics.exit_load: 1% if redeemed within 1 year; Nil after 1 year (365 days)

parsed_sections.Investment Objective: The scheme seeks to generate capital appreciation/income from a portfolio predominantly invested in equity & equity-related instruments across market capitalizations (Large Cap, Mid Cap, and Small Cap).
parsed_sections.Expense Ratio & Exit Load: Expense ratio is 0.77% (Direct Plan). Exit load is 1% if units are redeemed within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment. Nil exit load after 1 year.
parsed_sections.Minimum Investment & Liquidity: Minimum SIP investment is ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum investment is ₹100. No statutory lock-in period.
parsed_sections.Riskometer & Benchmark: Riskometer classification is Very High. Benchmark index is NIFTY 500 Total Return Index (TRI).
